title: Life events
description: Canonical life events for reuse by any tool. Only explicitly public events may be published; notes must never be published. The validator also enforces unique IDs and end_date >= date.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug. beets-library-import is reserved for the derived album-graph bookmark.

date.description: ISO calendar date. Use the first day of the represented period for coarser precision.

visibility.description: Required publication decision, with no default.

note.description: Private context; never published, including for public events.
